scope: CPU-only analysis of immutable, already closed probe/control and historical all-arm evidence. No native, existing tool, PLAN, controller, build, GPU or Git operations.

commands.command: E:/Anaconda/envs/DL/python.exe -B - (independent NumPy double3 cross-check supplied on stdin)
commands.scope: 2 same-program on/off pairs and 6 old-program all-repeat pairs, all 121 state and actual velocity exports, both body types
